title: ZeroDivisionError in shipping rate calculation for digital orders
description: When users purchase digital-only products (such as eBooks or virtual gift cards) with zero shipping weight, the checkout fails with HTTP 500. The stack trace shows a ZeroDivisionError in the shipping rate calculation function.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/shipping_service.py', line 14, in calculate_shipping_rate
    cost_per_kg = 15.0 / weight_kg
ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero
recent_changes: Commit 4b92c1: Updated variable parcel shipping tariff calculations
expected_behavior: Zero-weight digital items should incur $0 weight charge without throwing ZeroDivisionError
